contexts.text: The assumption of the Human by the Lord in the world, which is called the incarnation.
In the doctrine of the incarnation...
That this redemption itself could not have been effected, except by means of an incarnate God. Explained. CanonsNC 31. Redemption. 8.
After... God had become incarnate (this Trinity) was provided and effected. Explained.
This, now, is the mystery of the Lord's incarnation. Explained.
Redemption. 8. 2. All the worship of the Church before God had become incarnate foreshadowed and regarded Him after He had become incarnate...
Redemption. 8. 4. A non-incarnate God could not fight against the Hells.
Redemption. 8. 5. A non-incarnate God could not be tempted.
Redemption. 8. 6. A non-incarnate God could not be seen and Known, thus could not be approached, and thus could not be conjoined with men and Angels, except by means of Himself become incarnate.
Redemption. 8. 7. Faith in a God not incarnated is impossible. It is possible only in Him become incarnate.
Redemption. 9. God showed Himself to the ancients by means of Angels, in the human form, which form was representative of the incarnate God.
Redemption... which has been effected by Jehovah God incarnate, who is our Lord Jesus Christ.
Because Jehovah had not yet put on the Natural Human, which [was done] by means of incarnation in the womb of Mary.
Before the incarnation of Jehovah had been effected, conjunction could not be effected except through an Angel...
